title: ITVX / Cross-channel campaign composite
slide_intent: Compare which elements stay recognizable across campaign formats, because stable relationships help viewers recognize changing content as one service.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen recognition across a varied campaign.
demonstration: A supplied composite brings together a Des poster, a phone with audience copy, a typographic placement and a wide talent billboard. Yellow, dark grounds and arrow forms recur.
practical_value: Compare which elements stay recognizable across campaign formats.
